Description

The 7-a-side grass football pitch at Harris Primary Academy Crystal Palace offers a well-maintained natural grass surface in a welcoming and accessible location in Crystal Palace, South London. Perfect for weekend football, the pitch is available for hire on Saturdays and Sundays and can accommodate everything from friendly matches and local team training sessions to small tournaments or community events.

Set within the grounds of the school, the pitch provides a safe, enclosed environment with plenty of space for players and spectators. Its natural grass surface is regularly maintained to ensure a smooth and enjoyable playing experience, suitable for both casual and competitive games.

The venue benefits from excellent transport links, with Crystal Palace and Anerley stations nearby, as well as local bus routes and on-street parking options for easy access. Both single and repeat bookings are available, allowing teams and groups to secure regular slots or arrange one-off matches with ease.

Whether you’re looking to organise a weekend kickabout with friends or establish a consistent training base for your team, Harris Primary Academy Crystal Palace provides a convenient and community-focused setting for high-quality grassroots football in South London.
